name: request-flow
title: Request flow
description: A three-step request with inline validation, an error summary, evidence upload with progress, a confirmation dialog and a success state.
docs: Render <RequestFlow /> inside your ThemeScope (it follows the theme, scheme, density and locale around it). Its copy and data live in components/request-flow/request-flow.content.ts: pass your own object as `content` to translate or rebrand it.
